other_conditions: Must not be a member of the Armed Forces, Police Forces, recognized fire services, or a government servant (if the act falls within duty)
Must have performed a conspicuous act of physical/moral courage during communal riots, caste conflicts, or ethnic clashes, involving danger to the rescuer
Nomination must be made through the State Government or Union Territory Administration
benefits_summary: Cash award of ₹2 lakh, ₹1 lakh or ₹50 thousand depending on grade, together with a citation certificate
